tagline: Instantly zap files across your local network.
description: An interactive, offline-first CLI file transfer tool that uses a Textual TUI for visual file picking, Zeroconf for local device discovery, and QR codes for instant mobile downloads without needing a receiver app.

funding_plans.description: 2-month fellowship stipend to fund the engineering time required to build the core architecture, Textual TUI, Zeroconf integration, and the v1.0 PyPI release.
milestones: Milestone 1 (Month 1): Core Foundation - Implement textual-fspicker TUI, local HTTP server logic, and CLI QR generator for terminal-to-phone transfers.
Milestone 2 (Month 2): Ecosystem - Integrate Zeroconf (mDNS) for PC-to-PC discovery, update TUI for network targets, and publish the v1.0 containerized release to PyPI.
